builder.scope: Approved binary bootstrap compiler and build tools only. No bootstrap runtime objects, libraries, or headers may contribute shipped content. Not a full compiler bootstrap.

source_closure.link_input_policy: Every object and archive member must match a recorded source compilation. Installed musl runtime inputs must match source-built outputs.
source_closure.header_policy: Only locked source-tree headers and byte-matching installed musl headers. No bootstrap GCC headers.
source_closure.retained_evidence: Compiler commands, dependency records, preprocessed inputs, consumed input bytes, source archives, patches, effective BusyBox config, recipes, and licenses.
source_closure.excluded_claims: No full compiler bootstrap, trust-data audit, advisory completeness, independent-builder reproducibility, or FIPS validation.
